patch_description: This design treats each node’s two links as a small service portfolio: a pair is valuable when its neighbors jointly cover that node’s demand destinations, and less valuable when they offer redundant or imbalanced service. It builds demand-weighted one- to three-hop service profiles, then adds only the strongest pairwise portfolio preferences. Separately, a soft bottleneck score selects a small number of plausible two-hop routes for each demand, with modest rewards to avoid overvaluing indirect routing. This combines coverage and route support without reusing the earlier per-node residual expansion or broad two-hop reward scheme.
